newsitem.title: USA: FDA panel backs ok for Medtronic device.
newsitem.headline: FDA panel backs ok for Medtronic device.

text.p: ROCKVILLE, Md., March 14, Reuter - A Food and Drug Adminstration advisory committee on Friday voted 8-0 to recommend approval of an implantable device that uses a technique known as deep brain stimulation to help control tremors in patients with Parkinson's Disease and a condition called essential tremor.
Panelists were split on whether the device, made by Medtronic Inc, should be recommended for implantation on both sides of the brain, citing a lack of data.
About two million Americans have tremors due to these two diseases.
